body:
More on Giant Leech from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Leech, Giant (3pp)" but are not part of the Giant Leech entry, which is unchanged.

A large bloated leech floats in the muck and slime.

Giant Leech
CR 2

XP 600
N Medium vermin (aquatic)
Init +1; Senses blindsight 30 ft., scent; Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 11, touch 11, flat-footed 10 (+1 Dex)
hp 19 (3d8+6)
Fort +5, Ref +2, Will +1
Immune vermin traits
Weaknesses vulnerability to salt

OFFENSE

Speed 5 ft., swim 20 ft.
Melee bite +2 (1d6 plus attach)
Special Attacks attach, blood drain (1 Strength and 1 Constitution)
